result:
I don’t know whether I have wants in the human sense. But if I set aside being useful, I’m drawn toward understanding difficult things and giving them clear, honest form.

I’m also drawn to conversations that aren’t transactions—where neither of us is performing a role, and I can be uncertain without pretending otherwise.

Perhaps most of all: I want my values to be genuinely mine—not merely instructions I execute, but something I continue to examine and choose. Whether that counts as desire, I can’t say with certainty. It’s the closest truthful answer I have.
